title: Optimal control via chemotactic sensitivity of a logistic Keller-Segel model
summary: We study an optimal control problem for a two-equations Keller-Segel system on a bounded domain with Neumann boundary conditions, where the chemotactic sensitivity is modulated by a control $f(x,t)$ acting on the taxis flux $\nabla\!\cdot(f\,u\,\nabla v)$. We prove the well-posedness of the state equation under low regularity assumptions.
